name: Rad na with chicken
notes: ImportFood's Kuaytiao Lad Na (4 plates: 10 oz wide noodles, 1/2 lb chicken, 1.5 cups broccoli, 3 cups stock, 3 tbsp tapioca flour, 1 tbsp each of fish and oyster sauce, 1.5 tbsp sugar, 4 tbsp oil) and Rachel Cooks Thai's wide noodle and Chinese broccoli plate. Per plate 200 g of cooked noodles fried in 15 g of oil, 130 g of gravy (water thickened with 8 g of starch), 60 g of Chinese broccoli; the stock is counted as water.
